The pages (routes) this journey visited, in order. Short path trims the list: a start shared by every journey shows once in this header, a long middle folds into +N steps, and the last page always shows. Hover a journey to see its full path; Details always shows it. A page that is not a sub-page of the one before it starts with /, so it reads as a full path rather than as part of the page before.
How far the user's journey got — not whether you have a test for it. Completed: a submit, then a different page. Navigated: typing, then a different page, with no submit seen.

A spec needs attention when its result is mixed, or when evidence about it is missing, unreadable or out of date. Six things count: a test that failed at least once and then passed on a retry, a pass a newer test run has already overtaken, a spec the last run did not include, a spec that has never been run, an artifact that could not be read, and a failure with no heal result behind it. Each row opens a Details drawer saying which one applies to it and what to run next; the Repair path column offers the command to copy, the proposed diff to read, or the details to open.
